breaking_news.headline: How personal data is being used to control what customers see and pay
breaking_news.summary: NPR's Joel Rose speaks with Lindsay Owens, president of the economic think tank Groundwork Collaborative, about how companies using data to transform the products and prices customers see.

breaking_news.headline: 2 Americans win Nobel Prize in economics for work on boom-bust cycles
breaking_news.summary: Two Americans have won the Nobel Prize in economics for their work on how to smooth boom-and-bust cycles to limit unemployment and inflation.

breaking_news.headline: Farmers say they'll take the relief of Trump's EO — but they're still hurting
breaking_news.summary: President Trump says his Monday executive order temporarily suspending federal taxes on diesel will be a big relief for farmers. Some farmers call it a campaign ploy with marginal impact.

breaking_news.headline: What ice cream has to do with this year's Nobel Prize in economics
breaking_news.summary: Prices can get sticky. That helps explain why recessions hurt so much — and what policymakers can do about them.

breaking_news.headline: CNN, MS NOW and Politico prevail against White House — for now
breaking_news.summary: A federal judge ruled late Tuesday that President Trump cannot ban news organizations from covering him at the White House because he does not like the nature of their coverage - at least, not until the matter goes to a formal trial.

breaking_news.headline: VIDEO: The skincare sample is free. What happens next can cost thousands
breaking_news.summary: For years, customers have complained of aggressive sales tactics and charges at mall skincare stores. NPR investigated the business that connects many of them.

breaking_news.headline: The skincare scheme that led to consumer complaints, lawsuits and a federal investigation
breaking_news.summary: Free samples, high-pressure pitches and $50,000 bills: An NPR investigation reveals how a network of mall skincare stores systematically targeted older adults and people with disabilities across the U.S.

breaking_news.headline: Inflation sizzled in September — and Social Security benefits will get a boost
breaking_news.summary: Consumer prices in September jumped 3.7% from a year ago.  The Social Security Administration said benefits will increase next year to help keep pace with the rising cost of living.

breaking_news.headline: Sally Rooney books withdrawn in UK over Palestine Action support
breaking_news.summary: The Irish writer is best known for novels such as Normal People, Intermezzo and Conversations With Friends.

breaking_news.headline: At the Brooklyn novelty shop in 'surreal' row with Kelly Clarkson over mechanical bird
breaking_news.summary: Art of Play says its staff have been threatened after the singer complained online about how she was treated.

breaking_news.headline: 'Nowhere to escape' - Indonesians share footage of orange haze blanketing towns
breaking_news.summary: Thick orange smog descended on the Indonesian city of Palangka Raya as wildfires continue raging nearby.

breaking_news.headline: White House defends new press secretary amid questions about her legal credentials
breaking_news.summary: Katie Zacharia does not appear to be registered to the legal bar in any state where she has lived.

breaking_news.headline: Retired US generals call on Pentagon to cancel 'barbaric' execution livestream
breaking_news.summary: Livestreaming the execution of Nidal Hasan "will taint the honor of the military that employs it, and a nation that allows it," 72 former officers said in a letter.

breaking_news.headline: Student protesters attack government buildings in Albania
breaking_news.summary: Buildings were set alight on the second day of demonstrations from thousands of students who want better university conditions and job prospects.

breaking_news.headline: Musk says US government may be behind slowdown of Ukraine drone speeds
breaking_news.summary: Ukraine says Starlink access has improved but it is still facing speed limits which are disrupting its battlefield "missions".

breaking_news.headline: Netflix to shed 1,000 jobs in steepest cuts since 2022
breaking_news.summary: The cuts equate to around 6% of the streaming giant's total workforce worldwide.

breaking_news.headline: How much is the minimum wage?
breaking_news.summary: What are the National Minimum Wage and the National Living Wage, and how much are they worth?

breaking_news.headline: How a Chinese-made toy gets to a US retailer
breaking_news.summary: With Christmas on the horizon, we trace children's toys from factories in China to US shelves.

breaking_news.headline: Drop-off charges at UK airports to be reviewed after sharp increase
breaking_news.summary: Confirming the review, the government said it was "vital to ensure travel remains accessible and that passengers are treated fairly".

breaking_news.headline: 'I paid thousands to a company for jobs that never came'
breaking_news.summary: Apurv Patel is one of several people who say they were promised job opportunities that did not appear.
